title: Doha SO2 z<-1 -> TTF +2d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS SO2 20d z-score < -1 (Ras Laffan train outage proxy) leads TTF log returns by 2 days (+) via tighter European supply; trade long TTF=F 3d [airquality.doha.cams_so2 -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0029)
message: Not supported at lag 2 with z<-1 (r=-0.017, n=390); auto trade rule z>+1 long TTF 6d gives hit 55%, sharpe-like 1.36, OOS hit 62% (n=13) - weak, actionability 3.6

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_so2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Doha CAMS SO2 20d z-score > 1 (Ras Laffan full-throughput proxy) leads TTF/Henry Hub ratio changes by 6 days (+), testing whether the lag-6 SO2 edge is Europe-specific rather than a global gas move; trade long TTF=F 6d [airquality.doha.cams_so2 -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub] (parent: R2-0128)
